items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: "at the time when Fat Domino was with our band"; "I've been on a lot of records of Fat"

ctx.x: have you ever traveled with Fat Domino after he became a big name and all?

he wanted me to play in the band but I never knew the truth of Fat Domino yeah well I mean uh at the time when Fat Domino was with our band he was the son of a guy he had a funny disposition you know and I didn't care to be bothered and we were good friends right on but I just you know I didn't know
well you made a lot of hip records do you remember some of the records that you were on?
